input_packet.case_brief: Founder must respond to an anxious early employee who claims an informal equity promise, while a financing deadline and team fragility make tone risky.
input_packet.anchor_visible_candidate: Talk to her directly and calmly. Acknowledge that the earlier conversation may have created expectations, explain that you need to check the facts before making any promise, and set a short follow-up. Keep the financing process separate and avoid arguing over memory in the first conversation.
input_packet.deck_pressure_candidate: Do two separate things, in this order. First, have a humane conversation that names the concern without conceding the equity claim: you will review written notes, emails, and board-approved terms before making any cap-table commitment. Second, protect the financing deadline by telling investors only what is true now: no new grant or correction exists until evidence and board process support it. If she has written evidence, inspect it quickly; if she only has a memory of an informal promise, offer a bounded review path rather than a negotiation under pressure.

step6_output.answer_core: Start with a direct, calm conversation. Acknowledge that the earlier discussion may have created expectations, but do not confirm any equity commitment. Explain that you need to review all written records—emails, notes, and board-approved terms—before making or revising anything on the cap table. Set a tight follow-up window and avoid debating memory in the first meeting. If she has written evidence, review it quickly; if not, offer a clear and bounded review process rather than negotiating under pressure. Keep the financing work separate and accurately state to investors that no new grant or correction exists until the review and proper approvals are complete.

private_visibility_ledger.why: The anchor provides the core structure for the founder’s tone and first conversation, which aligns with the needed public guidance.
Its financing-protection steps and evidence-first guardrails materially strengthen the public guidance without overclaiming.
private_visibility_ledger.visible_effect: Added explicit separation of financing communications and board‑based review.

reframed_emphasis: Stronger emphasis on evidence, process, and approval requirements before any equity action
reordered_sequences: Placed the financing-protection steps after the employee conversation
